display_long_description:
Nightmare Tag is a multiplayer VR horror game set within the eerie, liminal spaces of your nightmares.

BECOME THE NIGHTMARE
Play as 3 monsters, each with 4 upgradable perks and a unique, physics-based motion mechanic:
- Entity: Wield terrifying speed and agility
- Mimic: Track voices and shapeshift into humans
- Crow: Stalk and ambush humans by changing your size from tiny to colossal

SURVIVE THE NIGHTMARE
Play as 4 unique humans, each with 4 upgradable perks:
- Characters: Antonio (teamwork), Charles (teleport), Madison (medic), Sadie (athlete)
- Slingshot: Stun monsters with heated pellets and adapt your strategy with attachments like Laser Beam, Boom Blast, Warp Shot, and Portal Pellet
- Scanner: Detect teammates, threats, attachments, and objectives through walls
- Run: Combine joystick movement with controller motion to sprint through the nightmare
- Hide: Turn invisible by standing completely motionless
- Climb: Grab onto nearly any surface to climb, vault, and outmaneuver monsters

CO-OP & MULTIPLAYER
- Nightmare Tag (PvP): 2–10 players hunt each other in 3 unique game modes including Quick Tag, VHS Run, and Elimination
- Nightmare Run (PvE): 1–8 players ascend an expanding dream world by completing objectives and scanning creatures to uncover their behavior

DEMO VS FULL GAME
Play for Free:
- Play as Antonio or the Entity
- Earn XP and upgrade perks
- Join any lobby

General Admission ($10):
- Unlock new characters with XP
- Host PvE lobbies
- +3000 Tokens
